AI/ML professional with nearly 4 years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. Seeking a challenging role in a forward-thinking organization to leverage data-driven insights, drive innovation, and deliver scalable AI solutions that create measurable business impact.
Proficient in end-to-end ML lifecycle from data collection and experimentation to API integration and model deployment.  An effective communicator with proven skills in working with cross-cultural teams during the project phase; guiding & training team members and enabling knowledge sharing among the team.
Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into robust AI architectures and measurable outcomes.  Demonstrated thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical blogging, and participation in AI research and innovation.  Recognized for delivering high business impact through AI-driven efficiency improvements, automation solutions, and customer-facing innovations.

   Achieved 4,000+ downloads within six months and earned 100+ GitHub stars, reflecting strong community adoption.

Implemented S3-based audit logging, IAM configuration analysis, and DynamoDB-backed model–

Mentoring an IIT Bombay student to build a hierarchical AI-agent evaluation system where agents self-assess and escalate low-quality outputs. Designed a modular evaluation pipeline using CrewAI and FastAPI, improved reliability over traditional assessment methods.
